## This file is automatically generated from /etc/audit/rules.d

########################################################################
# root commands
########################################################################
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -F euid=0 -S execve -k root-commands
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -F euid=0 -S execve -k root-commands


########################################################################
# Critical files
########################################################################
-w /etc/passwd -p wa -k passwd-access
-w /etc/shadow -p rwxa -k shadow-access
-w /etc/group -p wa -k group-access
-w /etc/fstab -p wa -k fstab-access
-w /etc/hostname -p wa -k hostname-access
-w /etc/hosts -p wa -k hosts-access
-w /etc/resolv.conf -p wa -k resolv-access
-w /etc/network/ -p wa -k network-access
-w /etc/pacman.conf -p wa -k pacman-conf-access
-w /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist -p wa -k mirrorlist-access
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k sudoers-access
-w /etc/systemd/system/ -p wa -k systemd-access
-w /etc/cron.d/ -p wa -k cron-d
-w /etc/cron.daily/ -p wa -k cron-daily
-w /etc/cron.hourly/ -p wa -k cron-hourly
-w /etc/cron.monthly -p wa -k cron-monthly
-w /etc/cron.weekly -p wa -k cron-weekly
-w /etc/rsyslog.conf -p wa -k rsyslog-config
-w /etc/logrotate.conf -p wa -k logrotate-config
-w /etc/hosts.allow -p wa -k hosts-allow
-w /etc/hosts.deny -p wa -k hosts-deny
-w /etc/sysctl.conf -p wa -k sysctl-config
-w /etc/login.defs -p wa -k login-defs
-w /etc/security/ -p wa -k security-config
-w /etc/pam.d/ -p wa -k pam-config
-w /etc/audit/ -p wa -k audit-config
-w /boot -p rwa -k boot-access


########################################################################
# SSH
########################################################################
# Modify sshd_config
-w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k ssh-config
# Successed connection
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid=0 -F path=/usr/bin/ssh -k ssh-login
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid=0 -F path=/usr/bin/ssh -k ssh-login
# Failed connection
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid!=0 -F path=/usr/bin/ssh -k ssh-failed
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid!=0 -F path=/usr/bin/ssh -k ssh-failed


########################################################################
# Based on recommandations
########################################################################

# Monitoring /etc
-w /etc -p wa -k modif-etc

#  Process created
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S execve,execveat -k proc-creation
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S execve,execveat -k proc-creation

# Program executed
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve,execveat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k user-exec
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S execve,execveat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k user-exec

# Memory read using debug API
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S process_vm_readv,process_vm_writev,ptrace -k debugging
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S process_vm_readv,process_vm_writev,ptrace -k debugging

# Memory reading with kernel module
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,finit_module -k kernel-driver
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module,finit_module -k kernel-driver

# Execute kmod (insmod, rmmod and modprobe)
-w /bin/kmod -p x -k kmod-exec

# Monitoring mount/unmount
-a exit,always -S mount -S umount2 -k mount-umount

# Syscalls
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S ioperm -S modify_ldt -k syscall
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S ioperm -S modify_ldt -k syscall
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S get_kernel_syms -S ptrace -k syscall
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S get_kernel_syms -S ptrace -k syscall
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S prctl -k syscall
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S prctl -k syscall

# loading/remove/change kernel module
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module -F key=module-load
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S init_module -F key=module-load
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S delete_module -F key=module-unload
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S delete_module -F key=module-unload
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S finit_module -F key=module-change
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S finit_module -F key=module-change

# Monitor file creation/deletion
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S rename -S rmdir -S unlink -F key=file-modif
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S rename -S rmdir -S unlink -F key=file-modif

-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mkdir -S mknod -S link -S symlink -F key=file-create
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mkdir -S mknod -S link -S symlink -F key=file-create

-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S creat -S open -S openat -F exit=-EACCES -k access-denied
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S creat -S open -S openat -F exit=-EACCES -k access-denied
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S truncate -S ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -k trunc-denied
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S truncate -S ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -k trunc-denied


# lock configuration
-e 2
